description: This PHP class 'ApiController' handles API responses, error handling, content negotiation, and request validation for SuiteCRM's v8 API, implementing JSON API standards and integrating with various SuiteCRM components.

classes.name: ApiController
classes.description: Controller class for handling SuiteCRM API v8 JSON API responses, error handling, and request validation.

methods.name: generateJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON API response with validation and error handling.

methods.name: handleExceptionIntoPayloadError
methods.description: Adds exception details into the response payload errors.

methods.name: generateJsonApiErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON API formatted error response based on exceptions.

methods.name: negotiatedJsonApiContent
methods.description: Performs content negotiation and validation of request headers.

methods.name: validateRequestWithJsonApiSchema
methods.description: Validates incoming request payload against JSON API schema.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the controller.
